speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) what is the progress on the initiative to roll out a big data sandbox in Singapore; (b) what is the prevalence of local businesses making use of big data to increase their competitiveness; and (c) what measures will be implemented to encourage more local businesses, especially the traditional ones, to integrate big data in their business strategies.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Unfortunately, many local companies are not taking advantage of this potential.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Many of these businesses said that they lacked awareness and the expertise to harness data science and AI or were concerned about breaching data protection regulations.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: First, we are making it easier for our small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to deploy such solutions.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Info-communications Media Development Authority's (IMDA's) SMEs Go Digital programme gives SMEs access to proven digital solutions to grow their businesses.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: These solutions come embedded with capabilities, such as data analytics, cybersecurity and data protection.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Over time, IMDA intends to raise the standards of these solutions with new technological capabilities, such as AI.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Several SMEs have successfully taken advantage of these solutions.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: So, I encourage Members to check out our #SMETowkay series showcasing SMEs, including Poh Kim Video, which have benefited from going digital.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: SMEs can contact their nearest SME Centres for advice on their digital needs.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Second, Sir, we are bringing companies together to realise the value of sharing data.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: For instance, it is working with the industry to scope problem statements through industry-led Data Collaboratives.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: These Data Collaboratives are essentially partnerships among businesses where the businesses identify a common business problem and share data with one another to solve those problems.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: IMDA is finalising the implementation details and will announce these when we are ready.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: There appears to be a misconception amongst businesses that the Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) prohibits the sharing of personal data.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This Guide seeks to provide clarity to businesses on how they can share personal data within and between organisations.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have two or three supplementary questions, but these are short questions.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: First, with regard to the role of the big data sandbox in my question earlier, can the Minister elaborate more about the progress of the initiative?

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I think the Minister mentioned briefly, but maybe he could share a bit more on the progress.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Second, I have heard of the Go Digital programme and I laud that programme.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: A lot of the SMEs are looking forward to that and more should take up that programme.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: But one area that may need to be looked upon, and maybe the Minister could share on this part, is about the exchangeable business intelligence in the future.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: For example, the 10% or 20% that is taken up, the extent of exchangeable business intelligence that they can use to enhance their profitability, in terms of consumer behaviour and consumer actions that they can take.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Will there be an increase in costs as well from that?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: But certainly, we want to go forward in creating that platform to allow companies to come together and share data.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: So, as I have mentioned in my reply, once it is ready, IMDA will announce the details.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I think for the next three questions, they are all inter-related.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I have personally visited many companies, small SME companies.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: The solutions are not deep-tech, they are really simple solutions.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: And the most important thing is for us to prove to the SMEs that it will benefit them.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I agree with the Member that this is a good effort, and we will continue to push this.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I had mentioned in my reply that within the solutions that we offer, we have also embedded within it the use of data analytics, cybersecurity and data protection, and we hope they can tap on that.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: In the SMEs Go Digital programme, there are many levels.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: Some companies are just starting off and, therefore, they need some basic solutions.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: The more advanced companies which have already deployed digital solutions, if they want to go into analytics, AI, or business intelligence, we will work with them.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: Within the Tech Hub, there will be experts who can offer advice to the companies on how they can use what they have deployed, to basically further raise their business profitability by leveraging technology.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: But we believe that, over the long run, if they are able to prove that it is profitable for their business, we hope they will be self-funded.
